svg.title: CLIP 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何表示或連接輸入與會形成什麼 candidate claim；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

g.data-semantic-relation: show the authored operation before action
g.data-must-show: CLIP：image/text normalized embeddings，以 v·t/τ 排受控候選 | candidate output: semantic candidate rank，不是 mask/probability | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: CLIP output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: CLIP：image/text normalized embeddings，以 v·t/τ 排受控候選
